token_set.name: Hoist the Cup 2026
token_set.description: Introducing Hoist the Cup 2026, a rare set celebrating the triumphs of the 2026 Stanley Cup champions. This premium collection captures the most electrifying moments from the Carolina Hurricanes journey through the Stanley Cup Playoffs. Relive the thrilling goals, spectacular saves, and defining plays that led to hockey's ultimate glory. Each highlight in this set commemorates the skill, determination, and passion that culminated in hoisting the coveted Stanley Cup.

description:
In Game 6 of the Stanley Cup Final, Taylor Hall — the veteran forward chasing his first Stanley Cup — delivered the series-clinching goal that capped the Carolina Hurricanes’ championship run. 
Early in the first period, off a stretch pass from Jaccob Slavin, Hall skated in on a partial break down the left wing and wired a precise wrist shot an inch under the goaltender’s glove at 3:47 to give Carolina a 1-0 lead in what became a dominant 3-0 shutout victory. 
Hall’s clutch tally not only clinched the series in six games but exemplified his impact throughout the 2026 playoffs, where he finished second on the team in scoring with 19 points and led the League in plus/minus at +14, as the Hurricanes captured the Stanley Cup.

description:
In Game 2 of the Stanley Cup Final, Seth Jarvis delivered the clutch overtime goal that allowed the Carolina Hurricanes to tie the series after a tough loss in Game 1 at home. 
Jarvis stepped up on the power play in overtime and thundered home a one timer from the right wing that beat the goaltender to secure a dramatic 4-3 victory. 
Jarvis’s heroics averted a potential 0-2 hole and proved to be a turning point in their resilient run to the 2026 Stanley Cup championship.

description:
In Game 6 of the Stanley Cup Final, Brandon Bussi — the undrafted goaltender who stepped up as a postseason hero for the Carolina Hurricanes — delivered an incredible shutout performance that clinched the championship in dominant fashion. 
Facing the Vegas Golden Knights with a chance to secure a championship, Bussi turned aside all 22 shots with poise and precision, making crucial stops throughout the night to preserve the blank sheet and secure a 3-0 victory that wrapped up the series in six games. 
Bussi played in only four games during the 2026 Stanley Cup Playoffs, all during the Final, where he posted a .931 save percentage and 1.60 goals-against average while winning all three games he started (3-1 record overall), as the Hurricanes captured the Stanley Cup.

description:
In Game 2 of the Eastern Conference Final, Nikolaj Ehlers — the speedy winger signed by the Carolina Hurricanes as a pivotal offseason addition — delivered a memorable two-goal performance that featured a dazzling individual effort and the overtime winner to even the series. 
With the game tied in the second period, Ehlers created magic on his own, carrying the puck between two defenders while shielding it with his body before turning and firing a shot through the legs of the goaltender to give Carolina the lead. His highlight-reel tally shifted the momentum in a tightly contested battle. 
Ehlers’ clutch contributions exemplified his impact throughout the 2026 playoffs, where he finished third on the team in scoring with 18 points, including eight goals, as the Hurricanes captured the Stanley Cup.

description:
In Game 5 of the Stanley Cup Final, Andrei Svechnikov delivered a huge two-goal performance that helped tilt the series decisively in the Carolina Hurricanes’ favor. 
His third period tally, his second of the game, was a thing of beauty on the power play, as he received a gorgeous spinning pass and deftly tapped the puck into the net at the post to extend the lead to 4-1 and put the game out of reach. 
Svechnikov’s two goals proved instrumental in the 4-2 victory that gave Carolina a 3-2 series lead and propelled the Hurricanes toward their 2026 Stanley Cup championship.

description:
In the 2026 Stanley Cup Playoffs, Jaccob Slavin — the shutdown defenseman relied upon all postseason to shut down the opponents’ best offensive players and cornerstone of the Carolina Hurricanes’ blue line — delivered exceptional defensive play that anchored their championship run. 
Featured in this highlight are two standout moments that showcased his elite instincts and reliability: In Game 3 of the Second Round against the Philadelphia Flyers, Slavin made an incredible goal-line stop, reaching across the crease in spectacular fashion to deny what looked like a sure goal and preserve Carolina’s momentum in their 4-1 victory. Then, in Game 6 of the Stanley Cup Final, Slavin’s great effort broke up Jack Eichel’s dangerous rush with perfect positioning and quick stick work, forcing a turnover and thwarting a potential scoring chance in the Cup-clinching 3-0 shutout. 
Slavin’s exceptional defensive mastery exemplified his impact throughout the playoffs and helped propel the Hurricanes to their 2026 Stanley Cup victory.
